title: Explain the repository in its About description
review: Write a specific description naming the audience and output.
remediation: Write a specific description naming the audience and output.

title: Use relevant repository topics
review: Select accurate topics that match the implemented scope; do not keyword-stuff.
remediation: Select accurate topics that match the implemented scope; do not keyword-stuff.

title: Provide a nonempty README
review: Add a Markdown README explaining the project and its first-use path.
remediation: Add a Markdown README explaining the project and its first-use path.

title: State purpose, audience and boundaries
review: Ask an unfamiliar reader to identify what this does, for whom, and what it does not do.
remediation: Ask an unfamiliar reader to identify what this does, for whom, and what it does not do.

title: Provide a complete first-use sequence
review: Check prerequisites, clone or installation, working directory, commands and expected output. Alternate heading names are acceptable.
remediation: Check prerequisites, clone or installation, working directory, commands and expected output. Alternate heading names are acceptable.

title: Keep supported local Markdown targets resolvable
review: Repair missing local files and references; manually verify deferred anchors and complex Markdown syntax.
remediation: Repair missing local files and references; manually verify deferred anchors and complex Markdown syntax.

title: Use purposeful and accessible badges
review: Explain each badge claim, use meaningful alt text and a useful click target, and remove redundant decoration.
remediation: Explain each badge claim, use meaningful alt text and a useful click target, and remove redundant decoration.

title: Scope workflow badges to branch and event
review: Set explicit branch and event parameters on recognised CI badge URLs. This is a playbook preference, not a platform requirement.
remediation: Set explicit branch and event parameters on recognised CI badge URLs. This is a playbook preference, not a platform requirement.

title: Disclose limitations and evidence
review: Separate implemented, tested, measured, inferred and unknown claims. Include environments for measurements.
remediation: Separate implemented, tested, measured, inferred and unknown claims. Include environments for measurements.

title: Provide useful documentation navigation
review: Keep the README as an entry point; link guides, reference, architecture and troubleshooting without duplicating authority.
remediation: Keep the README as an entry point; link guides, reference, architecture and troubleshooting without duplicating authority.

title: Explain the actual repository layout
review: Map source inputs, runtime code, tests, examples and generated outputs. Do not reorganise only to match a fashionable template.
remediation: Map source inputs, runtime code, tests, examples and generated outputs. Do not reorganise only to match a fashionable template.

title: Identify authoritative and generated files
review: Document source ownership and regeneration commands; prevent manual edits to derived content.
remediation: Document source ownership and regeneration commands; prevent manual edits to derived content.

title: Document editor whitespace conventions
review: Add a project-appropriate .editorconfig rather than relying on personal editor settings.
remediation: Add a project-appropriate .editorconfig rather than relying on personal editor settings.

title: Provide contribution instructions
review: Document setup, validation and review expectations. Check inherited defaults before declaring a local absence a failure.
remediation: Document setup, validation and review expectations. Check inherited defaults before declaring a local absence a failure.

title: Provide a private security reporting route
review: Document a verified private reporting channel and supported versions; do not publish vulnerability details in public issues.
remediation: Document a verified private reporting channel and supported versions; do not publish vulnerability details in public issues.

title: State contributor behaviour and enforcement
review: Provide a conduct policy with a real escalation route; presence alone does not establish enforceability.
remediation: Provide a conduct policy with a real escalation route; presence alone does not establish enforceability.

title: Make change review expectations discoverable
review: Add a lightweight PR template with purpose, verification and risk prompts.
remediation: Add a lightweight PR template with purpose, verification and risk prompts.

title: Make ownership and triage workable
review: Explain who reviews which areas and how issues are triaged; a solo project need not pretend to have a committee.
remediation: Explain who reviews which areas and how issues are triaged; a solo project need not pretend to have a committee.

title: Provide discoverable CI workflow configuration
review: Add appropriate automated checks. File presence is not evidence of passing runs or enforced checks.
remediation: Add appropriate automated checks. File presence is not evidence of passing runs or enforced checks.

title: Test the documented behaviours
review: Review test assertions and run evidence, including examples, edge cases and failure paths; do not infer test quality from a script name.
remediation: Review test assertions and run evidence, including examples, edge cases and failure paths; do not infer test quality from a script name.

title: Check generated-output freshness
review: Regenerate deterministically and compare without writing in PR checks. Route intentional changes through normal review.
remediation: Regenerate deterministically and compare without writing in PR checks. Route intentional changes through normal review.

title: Cover observed dependency manifests in version-update policy
review: Compare actual external dependency directories and GitHub Action references with the checked-in Dependabot configuration. Check external updaters manually.
remediation: Configure every relevant ecosystem and directory, or document verified alternative update automation. Do not assume root npm covers nested npm packages.

title: Pin workflow Actions and avoid write-all tokens
review: Inspect external uses for full immutable commit hashes, look for write-all token grants, and manually review privileged events and unrecognised YAML patterns.
remediation: Pin external Actions to reviewed full commit SHAs, avoid write-all, and inspect unusual YAML or privileged execution by hand.

title: Require relevant checks before merging
review: Inspect effective branch protection and rulesets, required contexts and bypasses. Files in the repository do not enforce settings.
remediation: Inspect effective branch protection and rulesets, required contexts and bypasses. Files in the repository do not enforce settings.

title: Keep untrusted execution out of privileged contexts
review: Trace pull-request code, artifacts and interpolation through privileged jobs. Never grant a documentation checker broad write access.
remediation: Trace pull-request code, artifacts and interpolation through privileged jobs. Never grant a documentation checker broad write access.

title: Provide explicit licence text
review: Include the selected licence text and explain any code/data/upstream boundaries. Detection is not legal approval.
remediation: Include the selected licence text and explain any code/data/upstream boundaries. Detection is not legal approval.

title: Keep version and release policy consistent
review: Choose independent or synchronised package versions; align manifests, tags, runbooks and changelogs with that policy.
remediation: Choose independent or synchronised package versions; align manifests, tags, runbooks and changelogs with that policy.

title: Verify the distributed installation path
review: Test the built package in a fresh consumer directory, not just imports from the source tree.
remediation: Test the built package in a fresh consumer directory, not just imports from the source tree.

title: Control repository and history growth
review: Measure large objects and history separately from working-tree size. Do not rewrite shared history as an automatic fix.
remediation: Measure large objects and history separately from working-tree size. Do not rewrite shared history as an automatic fix.

title: Keep CI cost proportional to risk
review: Inspect duration, cache trust, redundant jobs, cancellation and retention; optimise measured bottlenecks rather than adding unsafe caching.
remediation: Inspect duration, cache trust, redundant jobs, cancellation and retention; optimise measured bottlenecks rather than adding unsafe caching.

title: Provide project-specific agent instructions
review: Add concise AGENTS.md instructions for commands, boundaries, generated paths and evidence requirements.
remediation: Add concise AGENTS.md instructions for commands, boundaries, generated paths and evidence requirements.

title: Communicate maintenance status and handover
review: State experimental, active, maintenance or archived status and migration paths. Infrequent commits alone do not indicate abandonment.
remediation: State experimental, active, maintenance or archived status and migration paths. Infrequent commits alone do not indicate abandonment.

title: Record catalogue provenance and unknowns
review: Store primary sources, reviewed dates, schema constraints and explicit unknowns. Do not promote sourced claims to reproduced measurements.
remediation: Store primary sources, reviewed dates, schema constraints and explicit unknowns. Do not promote sourced claims to reproduced measurements.

title: Separate catalogue code, data and upstream rights
review: Explain what licence covers each material and preserve upstream ownership. A catalogue listing is not a grant of model rights.
remediation: Explain what licence covers each material and preserve upstream ownership. A catalogue listing is not a grant of model rights.

title: Document environment and deployment boundaries
review: Provide safe example configuration, deployment and rollback steps, and clearly separate client-visible from secret values.
remediation: Provide safe example configuration, deployment and rollback steps, and clearly separate client-visible from secret values.

title: Document operation and recovery
review: Explain monitoring, data backups, recovery checks and failure behaviour appropriate to the actual application.
remediation: Explain monitoring, data backups, recovery checks and failure behaviour appropriate to the actual application.

title: Present a title and useful introduction above the fold
review: Check that a recognizable project heading and plain-language purpose appear before extended tables, badges, changelogs or installation details. Supports only simple Markdown heuristics.
remediation: Place a project heading and one understandable sentence before long navigation or status content. Verify the rendered README separately.

title: Describe nondecorative documentation images accessibly
review: Inspect README and docs images for explanatory alt text. Empty alt can be correct for purely decorative images; badges are excluded from the visual inventory.
remediation: Give meaningful screenshots, diagrams and figures descriptive alt text; use empty alt only for intentional decoration.

title: Review first-screen hierarchy and badge density
review: Inspect the rendered GitHub README in light and dark modes, on mobile and desktop. Check top links, badge claims, contrast, tables, visual density and scannability.
remediation: Make the next action obvious, preserve evidence-backed badges, and move detail into linked sections instead of crowding the hero.

title: Review social preview and share-card representation
review: GitHub repository social-preview imagery is not available from the supported read-only REST endpoints. Inspect Settings > General > Social preview only when public sharing matters.
remediation: Use a representative, readable preview for public promotion; document unavailable settings rather than pretending a missing preview is proven.

title: Keep product imagery representative of current behaviour
review: Compare any screenshots, demo GIFs and hero illustrations with a current running example. Images may be optional for command-line or data-only projects.
remediation: Remove stale screenshots, label prototypes, and show truthful examples rather than conceptual-only imagery presented as shipped UX.

title: Configure a useful homepage or docs destination when relevant
review: Inspect GitHub About homepage. Blank is not a defect when no live site or external documentation exists; URL availability and ownership need separate review.
remediation: If a real demo or docs site exists, place its canonical URL in About and verify it independently. Never invent a homepage.

title: Choose intentional public, private or internal visibility
review: Assess repository visibility against its audience and disclosure policy. Public visibility is not intrinsically superior to private.
remediation: Confirm intended access before changing repository visibility; keep confidential code and credentials private.

title: Investigate an unrecognized GitHub licence label
review: GitHub can display Other/NOASSERTION for custom or split code/data licensing. Classifier recognition is separate from whether the actual licence files are correct.
remediation: Cross-check LICENSE, data/asset licences and the README. Clarify scope; do not change legal terms just to obtain a recognized badge.

title: Make archive state match the repository lifecycle
review: Decide whether GitHub archive status matches maintenance promises. An intentionally frozen example can be complete even without recent commits.
remediation: If archived, add support/upgrade alternatives and handover notes; if active, avoid suggesting it is permanently frozen.

title: Keep About metadata, topics and README scope consistent
review: Compare the card title, description, language label, topics, README claims and available files. Topic presence alone does not establish relevance.
remediation: Revise outdated descriptions and remove irrelevant topics; avoid fake keyword strategies, star requests and search-ranking promises.

title: Review hosted documentation discovery and share metadata
review: When a public documentation site exists, inspect title, description, canonical URL, robots rules and linkability. Indexing/ranking is not measurable from a local checkout.
remediation: Add meaningful metadata to a real site and manually verify sharing and search indexing. Mark not relevant when no public site exists.

title: Review explicit unfinished README placeholders
review: Look for narrow editorial markers such as TODO:, TBD and Lorem ipsum. The absence of markers does not prove work is finished; examples may deliberately contain them.
remediation: Replace stale placeholder text or clearly mark it as an example or planned work. Keep roadmaps truthful.

title: Reconcile advertised features with demonstrable behaviour
review: Compare each prominent feature claim with working source, a reproducible example, observed test or real deployed behaviour. Code presence is insufficient to verify a claim.
remediation: Label planned, experimental and operational capabilities separately, adding reproduction steps and evidence for shipped features.

title: Validate the complete first-user journey
review: Follow installation, setup, permissions, examples, expected output and troubleshooting as a new user. Never execute target code merely to generate an automatic audit.
remediation: Exercise the documented path in an isolated environment with author approval; record actual result and version.

title: Distinguish complete, experimental and planned scope
review: Find the current product status, supported targets, known limitations and open milestones. A roadmap is not evidence that its items have shipped.
remediation: Keep a small truthful status and limitation section; give a release/milestone evidence link for important claims.

title: Verify release, installation and support expectations
review: Compare version and changelog, package manifest, documented installation, downloadable artifacts and maintenance policy. Presence of a tag does not guarantee installation.
remediation: Test versioned distribution and installation in CI or a documented release runbook; explain support expectations.

title: Match demo and example data with actual outputs
review: Confirm demo links, example output files and benchmark claims are reproducible and correctly labelled. Screenshots and generated metadata may be outdated.
remediation: Provide a small, reproducible example and date or revision-tagged results; separate illustrative concepts from tested outputs.
